question: For item lines belonging to 2025 orders, join to the food dimension and classify each line as Veg, Non-Veg, or Unknown (null or unmatched food ID). Report for each group: (1) item-line count, (2) total ordered units, (3) share of total ordered units computed as group ordered units divided by the sum of ordered units across all three groups times 100. State the total ordered units used as the denominator.

action.query:
WITH categories AS (
    SELECT column1 AS food_group
    FROM VALUES ('Veg'), ('Non-Veg'), ('Unknown')
), classified_lines AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN f.FOOD_ID IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'VEG' THEN 'Veg'
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(f.VEG_OR_NON_VEG)) = 'NON-VEG' THEN 'Non-Veg'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS food_group,
        i.ORDER_ITEM_ID,
        i.QUANTITY
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER_ITEM AS i
    INNER JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER AS o
        ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
    LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_FOOD AS f
        ON i.FOOD_ID = f.FOOD_ID
    WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
), group_totals AS (
    SELECT
        food_group,
        COUNT(ORDER_ITEM_ID) AS item_line_count,
        SUM(QUANTITY) AS ordered_units
    FROM classified_lines
    GROUP BY food_group
), denominator AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ordered_units), 0) AS total_ordered_units
    FROM group_totals
)
SELECT
    c.food_group,
    COALESCE(g.item_line_count, 0) AS item_line_count,
    COALESCE(g.ordered_units, 0) AS ordered_units,
    d.total_ordered_units,
    CASE
        WHEN d.total_ordered_units = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE COALESCE(g.ordered_units, 0) * 100.0 / d.total_ordered_units
    END AS share_of_total_ordered_units_pct
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN group_totals AS g
    ON c.food_group = g.food_group
CROSS JOIN denominator AS d
ORDER BY CASE c.food_group WHEN 'Veg' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-Veg' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

action.answer:
For item lines belonging to orders with ORDER_DATE from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, classified by the joined food dimension:

| Group | Item-line count | Ordered units | Share of total ordered units |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Veg | 7,277,939 | 8,877,759 | 72.584811% |
| Non-Veg | 2,749,222 | 3,353,105 | 27.415082% |
| Unknown (null/unmatched food ID, or other unclassified food value) | 12 | 13 | 0.000106% |

The denominator is **12,230,877 ordered units**, the sum of ordered units across all three groups. Shares may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.
